jobs.title: Software Engineer - Data Platforms & Analytics
jobs.description:
As a member of the Data Platforms & Analytics team, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our Data Platform solutions supporting reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision making across the organization.
The role is strongly focused on Avaloq data ecosystems , combining PL/SQL, ODI (Oracle Data Integrator), Snowflake and ACP(Avaloq Core Platform) knowledge to deliver high-quality, scalable, and governed data solutions.

Your key tasks

• Contribute to the integration of Avaloq Core Platform (ACP) data (e.g., transactional, reference, and business data) into our Data Platform solutions

• Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) , including mappings, packages, and scenario lifecycle management

• Design and support Snowflake data platform workloads , including data loading, transformation logic, and optimization of storage and compute usage

• Deploy, manage, and monitor data platform components running on Kubernetes (K8s) environments

## Qualifiche

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

• Proven experience in data engineering / data platform development including ETL/ELT patterns and data integration architectures

• Strong hands-on experience with  PL/SQL  in enterprise environments

• Experience with large-scale databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySql, Microsoft SQL Server)

• Effective communication skills in English (written and spoken)
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience with Avaloq Core Platform (ACP) and Avaloq data structures, ACCP certification (Avaloq Certified Customization Professional – ABR/S) is strongly preferred

• Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) for designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines

• Experience with Snowflake cloud data platform for analytics and data warehousing

• Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) for deploying and managing containerized applications

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Architect - Client Advisory
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Architect to join our Client Advisory team, with the objective of supporting commercial activities and contributing to the design of innovative technology solutions for enterprise clients.
This role operates in close collaboration with Sales, Key Account Managers (KAM), Solution Consultants, and Solution Managers, contributing in a highly integrated manner across the entire sales lifecycle. The position requires a strong team-oriented mindset and the ability to bridge technical expertise with business vision to deliver consistent, high-value client propositions.
Your key tasks

• Collaborate closely with Sales, KAMs, Solution Consultants, and Solution Managers to qualify opportunities and define the technical sales strategy

• Analyze client requirements (business and technical) and translate them into scalable, secure, and compliant cloud architectures

• Design end-to-end infrastructure solutions (compute, network, storage, security, disaster recovery)

• Contribute to the preparation of RFPs, RFIs, and technical proposals, including effort estimation, sizing, and costing

• Participate in technical workshops, collaborative sessions, and client presentations

• Work in alignment with delivery, security, and compliance teams to ensure feasibility and adherence to internal standards

• Support pricing definition and TCO/ROI analysis

• Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement of pre-sales methodologies and solution design practices

## Qualifiche

• Proven experience (5+ years) in cloud infrastructure and/or solution architecture roles

• Strong knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (OCI preferred, AWS or Azure)

• Experience designing highly available and resilient architectures

• Solid understanding of networking, security, IAM, backup, and disaster recovery

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)

• Strong collaboration skills in cross-functional environments

• Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and producing technical documentation

• Proven experience in banking, financial services, or insurance (regulated environments)

• Proven ability to produce high-quality professional documentation (e.g., proposals, architectural designs, technical reports)

• Ability to prepare and deliver executive-level presentations (C-level deck slides)

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, DORA)

• Cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)

• German, French, and Italian

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

Your key tasks
Team Leadership and People Management

• Lead and manage a team of infrastructure specialists across Unix, Windows, Database, Network, Middleware, and Kubernetes domains, with full accountability for performance and delivery outcomes

• Enforce rigorous performance management standards, mandate professional development aligned with organisational requirements, and ensure continuous skills evolution

• Establish and maintain a disciplined, accountable, and delivery-focused team culture with clear performance expectations

• Oversee capacity planning, workload allocation, and resource management to ensure optimal utilisation and delivery commitments are met
Technical Governance and Delivery Oversight

• Ensure consistent and compliant execution of all infrastructure activities, including project delivery, change implementation, and operational support, with zero tolerance for deviations from established standards

• Maintain rigorous oversight of technical quality, enforce adherence to standards and architectural guidelines, and validate all technical solutions against governance requirements

• Serve as the definitive escalation point for complex technical issues and cross-domain dependencies, with authority to make binding technical decisions

• Oversee design reviews and mandate proper validation of all technical solutions prior to implementation
Project and Change Coordination

• Direct local team contributions across multiple infrastructure projects and change initiatives, ensuring full alignment with enterprise delivery schedules

• Enforce readiness protocols for all implementation activities, including mandatory testing, cutover planning, and rollback procedures

• Coordinate directly with project managers, architects, and service owners to ensure seamless integration and accountability across all delivery touchpoints

• Enforce strict compliance with change management processes and audit requirements; maintain comprehensive documentation and audit trails
Stakeholder and Vendor Interaction

• Serve as the primary point of contact and authoritative voice for local technical teams in all communications with internal stakeholders and external partners

• Provide transparent reporting on delivery status, risks, resource constraints, and escalate critical issues immediately to senior leadership

• Direct coordination of activities with nearshore/offshore teams and third-party vendors, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements
Continuous Improvement and Innovation

• Mandate adoption of automation, standardisation, and Infrastructure as Code practices across all team operations

• Identify and implement improvements to delivery efficiency and operational processes, with measurable outcomes and accountability

• Oversee knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives within the team, ensuring compliance with organisational standards and best practices

## Qualifiche

• 7+ years of experience delivering IT infrastructure projects or leading complex technical change initiatives within enterprise environments

• Strong expertise in at least one core infrastructure domain (Unix, Windows, Database, Network, Middleware, or Kubernetes), combined with a solid understanding of other infrastructure technologies

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is mandatory, along with experience in Azure and/or AWS environments

• Proven track record of coordinating technical specialists and successfully delivering complex, multi-domain infrastructure projects

• Strong understanding of enterprise change management, testing, deployment planning, project governance, and risk management processes, ideally within regulated industries

• 3+ years of experience leading technical project teams, managing stakeholders, and driving project delivery across multiple workstreams

• Excellent project management skills, including planning, resource coordination, budget oversight, and management of cross-functional dependencies

We are seeking an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) with strong expertise in Oracle technologies and solid knowledge of other database platforms. The role focuses on the administration, evolution, and migration of enterprise database environments, supporting critical applications and transformation initiatives across the organization.
Key Responsibilities

• Administer Oracle Database environments as the primary technology, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management.

• Manage and support additional database platforms such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, or other NoSQL solutions.

• Execute and coordinate  database migration projects , including cross-version upgrades, platform migrations, cloud migrations, and database consolidation initiatives.

• Plan and perform migrations from on-premise to cloud-based database services, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, or Azure.

• Support heterogeneous migration scenarios between different database technologies, ensuring data consistency, performance, and minimal service disruption.

• Implement and maintain high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including Oracle Data Guard, RAC, and equivalent technologies for other platforms.

• Define and execute backup, restore, and recovery procedures across multiple database systems.

• Monitor and optimize database performance, capacity, storage, and resource utilization.

• Troubleshoot incidents, performance bottlenecks, replication issues, and database-related application problems.

• Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and project teams to design database solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

• Contribute to automation and standardization initiatives for database provisioning, patching, and deployment.

• 4+ years of experience as a Database Administrator with a strong focus on Oracle Database

• Hands-on experience managing Oracle databases in enterprise environments

• Experience with database migrations, upgrades, platform transformations, and cloud migration projects

• Strong knowledge of performance tuning, SQL optimization, backup & recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery

jobs.description:

• Cloud security posture and guardrails (secure-by-default baselines, policies, zones/guardrails)

• Network security posture and governance (firewalls, proxies, IDS/IPS, Cloudflare-based services, NSGs/security lists)

• Run a sustainable network rule governance model (inventory, periodic re-accreditation/recertification, exception handling, audit readiness)

• Eigene und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Cloud & Network Security-Service-Bereichs, einschließlich:
• Cloud-Sicherheitshaltung und Schutzschienen (sichere Basislinien, Richtlinien, Zonen/Werbeschienen)

• Drive Automation-erste Operationen: Überwachung, Metriken, Alarmierung, Playbooks, Inventarautomatisierung, Konfigurationsvalidierung und Driftprävention

• Fähigkeit, eine Backlog/Roadmap zu verwalten und Stakeholder auszurichten, während Sie pragmatisch und lieferorientiert bleiben
• Klare Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über technische und nichttechnische Publikum
• Fluent auf Englisch Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie
• Erfahrung mit Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security Services (z.B. Security Zones, Cloud Guard, Vault, Certificate Authority) und/oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Native Security Stacks
• Erfahrung mit Cloudflare, Fortinet, Check Point und/oder Firewall-Orchestrierung/Governance-Tooling
• Automatisierungskompetenzen: Terraform, CI/CD, Python

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, fast learner and well rounded, AI Software Engineer to join our AI innovation lab team. The ideal candidate will lead AI experiments and bring cutting-edge AI Agentic solutions from ideation to production.
The mission of Avaloq AI Lab is to improve operational efficiency and augment Back-to-Front Office user experiences, through the application of state-of-the-art AI technology. We work collaboratively with industry leaders to deliver responsible and impactful solutions. Our team develops products tailored to the banking sector, supporting a broad range of users including banking operations, software engineers, knowledge services teams, and relationship managers.
Your key tasks

• Lead AI experiments and develop solutions from ideation to production

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement Agentic AI solutions

• Develop advanced prompts, multi-Agents architecture and tools

• Deploy and maintain LLM based solutions in production

• Optimize solutions for performance, cost, and scalability

• Stay up-to-date and evaluate the latest advancements in AI research and related regulations

## Qualifiche

• At least B.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong background in data science, statistics, and experimental thinking

• Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

• Effective communication and collaboration skills

• Excellent analytical, coding, and debugging skills in Python

• At least 5 years of experience in Full-Stack Software Development

• At least 3 years of applied ML experience, with 2 years of experience with LLMs and Agents

• Proven track-record of deploying and maintaining AI models in production

• ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn or similar

• RAG pipelines with vector stores (e.g., Chroma, Qdrant)

• Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI)

• Cloud AI services e.g. AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), Azure (AI Studio), GCP (Vertex AI)

• LLM & Agent Ops - experiment tracking tools, observability tools, evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering and maintenance tools

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g. Docker) and container orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes)

• Micro-services and REST APIs

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Planning, Analysis and Controlling
jobs.description:
As the Head of FP&A and Controlling, you are the architect of our financial future. This is a high-impact, strategic leadership position designed for a finance expert who can translate complex data into actionable business intelligence, partnering with the business to maximize the value of Avaloq.
You will lead a high-performing multi-country team of 20+, overseeing everything from rigorous bottom-up budgeting to high-level strategic long-range planning and daily controllership for our departments. You will be the CFO’s right hand, ensuring that our financial steering, business partnering, and controlling functions align perfectly with our growth targets.
Key tasks:
Strategic financial planning & analysis

• Lead the development of long-term financial strategies and 3–5 year models that support global expansion and capital allocation in line with our mid-term plan aspirations.

• Conduct sophisticated "what-if" analyses and risk assessments to evaluate potential business outcomes and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

• Analyze industry trends and the competitive landscape to shape effective strategies and establish market standard KPIs to track organizational success.

As the Head of Strategic Finance Projects , you will play a key role in reshaping our global finance operations. You will connect Finance, IT, and broader business teams to ensure that our systems not only meet current needs but also bolster our future growth and efficiency. Beyond the primary ERP consolidation and advancement, you will drive other strategic initiatives vital for Avaloq's overall success.
Key Tasks:
Project Management excellence

• Establish a robust project management structure for Finance. Implement industry-standard methodologies to ensure consistent delivery across the portfolio.

• Develop detailed project plans to ensure all milestones are met on schedule and within budget. Track performance, implement corrective actions and conduct rigorous post-project evaluations .

• Independently execute key projects with a global team and an optimized resource allocation, always in best quality, time and budget

• Architect and lead the end-to-end project lifecycle for consolidating two legacy on-prem systems into a single, cohesive cloud-based solution.
The change agent: Modernity & efficiency

• Act as a tireless change agent, leading the Finance function out of legacy constraints and into a modern, automated, and scalable digital environment.

• Champion the "simplification first" principle. Before automating, you will challenge existing complexities to ensure we are building lean, efficient processes rather than just digitizing old ones.

• Ensure that new systems deliver systems that provide real-time insights, allowing Finance to act as a strategic advisor to the wider business.

• Foster a culture within the Finance organization that embraces industry-standard technology and continuous improvement.
Leadership and stakeholder engagement

• Lead and mentor the strategic projects team to boost performance and professional growth.; encourage innovative thinking and problem-solving within the Finance organization.

• Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, gathering feedback and leading meetings to promote transparency and set clear expectations.

• Develop and execute communication plans to keep the organization engaged and provide training to ensure smooth adoption of new systems.

• Strong proven track record of working in a similar role, ideally within a banking software provider

• You will have strong experience of ERP platforms, e.g., SAP, including implementations, upgrades and finance modules.

• Strong proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects where you manage the timelines, budget, risks and stakeholder engagement using your fantastic communication and drive.

• You will have evidence of leading at least one full ERP migration to the cloud for the full project life-cyle.

• You will have strong conceptual thinking skills and be proficient in data analysis and visualisation, but equally capable of explaining these complex concepts in an easy-to-understand way to those that dont.
